description: This PHP class 'SugarWidgetFieldEnum' defines various methods for handling report filtering, display, and ordering of enum type fields within SuiteCRM/SugarCRM. It extends 'SugarWidgetReportField' and includes functionalities like generating SQL queries for filters, rendering list views, and providing input controls for enum fields in reports.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldEnum
classes.description: Represents a reporting widget for enum fields in SuiteCRM, providing methods for generating query filters, display list, sorting, and input interface elements for enum-type fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the widget with the layout manager.

methods.name: queryFilterEmpty
methods.description: Generates SQL condition to filter records where the enum field is empty or null.

methods.name: queryFilterNot_Empty
methods.description: Generates SQL condition to filter records where the enum field is not empty.

methods.name: queryFilteris
methods.description: Creates a filter condition for a specific enum value.

methods.name: queryFilteris_not
methods.description: Creates a filter condition to exclude a specific enum value.

methods.name: queryFilterone_of
methods.description: Creates a filter to include records with enum values in a specified list.

methods.name: queryFilternot_one_of
methods.description: Creates a filter to exclude records with enum values in a specified list.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Renders an inline, possibly editable, display of the enum field in list views.

methods.name: displayListPlain
methods.description: Returns a plain string representation of the enum field, translating options as necessary.

methods.name: queryOrderBy
methods.description: Generates an ORDER BY clause for sorting reports based on enum field values.

methods.name: displayInput
methods.description: Provides an HTML select input for filtering by enum values in report filters.
